svg.title: Known-best packing of 229 unit squares, regularized
svg.desc: A regularized derived view of the retained known-best n=229 construction, never the source witness: its exact frame with the free grid slack closed and the near-axis squares straightened at the record's side, verified over the rationals (atlas/known-best/regularized/index.json), and rendered with the repository's deterministic house renderer. It changes no side, frontier value or evidence tier; the evidence stated here is the record's. Regularized by the Squares Project with Evan Daniel's regularizer (evand/square-packing, MIT).

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Complete 0075967 rational centre/half-angle certificate of a display-regularized view of a record packing solved to its exact side, converted exactly from the retained source. Finite construction feasibility only; no KKT, local minimum, same-packing, rigidity, novelty, priority or global optimality claim.

svg.text: U n=229 regularized: side ~ 15.65016151 (certified upper bound)
